# Test fixtures

Copied from `dataset/` in https://github.com/AutomataLab/cuJSON at commit
`38d27b6e6c4eb74205cf59f4123b0983034405e2`.

- `twitter_sample_large_record.json`: one standard JSON document (a top-level array)
- `twitter_sample_small_records.json`: JSON Lines, one record per line

Upstream's full-size evaluation datasets are linked from its `dataset/readme.md`.
